features.name: Positive-Y end support rail
features.description: End rail joining the two longitudinal rails at the positive-Y end. It includes an outer end wall, an inner cavity wall, an upper land, and an underside transition land.

feature_functions.name: Support shell end
feature_functions.description: Supports and closes the positive-Y end of the curved shell.

feature_functions.name: Connect side rails
feature_functions.description: Structurally connects the two longitudinal rails.

feature_behaviors.name: Spread end load
feature_behaviors.description: Spreads shell-end load across the cradle width.

feature_behaviors.name: Resist transverse bending
feature_behaviors.description: Acts as a cross-member between the two side rails.

relationships.description: The two end rails are mirrored across y=0 and have parallel end walls and lands.

brep_faces.name: Bottom perimeter mounting face
brep_faces.description: Planar bottom face forming the frame-shaped support footprint around the underside opening.
evidence: CadQuery reports two wires and area 3.040000 mm^2, consistent with an outer rectangular footprint containing an inner opening.
